title: authorization.role.assigned (v2)
description: A role was assigned to a user, service principal or group. Emitted for every new role assignment: through the administration API and as a side effect of organization creation (owner role), adding a member, accepting an invitation, approving a join request, ownership transfer, provisioning connectors and import jobs. org_id is set when the assignment is scoped to an organization; realm- and project-scoped assignments carry no org_id. The scope itself and the subject type are not included (the subject type follows from the subject_id prefix).

data.description: Event data. All members are identifiers or state, so the minimal and standard payload forms are identical.

organization_id.description: Set only when the event is bound to an organization (see description).
